content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-105.3. - Sick leave payout upon death or retirement.
content.summary:
The city may pay out sick leave upon death or retirement in accordance with a policy
               established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
